notes: HEFSP filed BER-L-000700-25 on 06/25/2025 (82 pages). Planner: Phillips Preiss Grygiel Leheny Keller LLC (Paul Grygiel AICP PP, NJ Planner #5518). DCA prospective need was 178 units; Borough modified to 164 units via Land Capacity Factor analysis and settled with FSHC. RDP is 5 units (VLA analysis). Unmet Need is 159 units. Post-2018 credits (Table 23): 36 credits total including 3 from 1 Franklin Turnpike, 16 from BCUW/Madeline group home, 8 from Life Opportunities Unlimited group home, 9 from Harrison Ave Redevelopment. Combined prior round/3rd round RDP of 81 fully addressed. AHO-1 and AHO-2 overlay zones proposed to address unmet need. 5 RDP units from 1 Franklin Turnpike + Harrison Ave rental units. Present need addressed by Bergen County Housing Rehabilitation Program.

sites.quote: 1 Franklin Turnpike – Block 18.01, Lot 17. The Zoning Board of Adjustment approved this development in 2021 and its construction was completed in 2022. The project consists of a building containing 11 multi-family residential units, including two affordable units.
sites.notes: Completed 2022. Zoning Board approved 2021. Generates 2 affordable units + 1 transit bonus = 3 total credits (Table 23). Non-age-restricted rental units. Partially addresses Fourth Round RDP of 5 units.

sites.quote: BCUW/Madeline Housing Partners – Block 163.16, Lot 18.01. This project involves the construction of a two-story group home occupied by persons with intellectual and developmental disabilities. A total of eight bedrooms are included in the development. It was approved by the Planning Board in 2022 and is currently under construction.
sites.notes: 8-bedroom group home for persons with intellectual/developmental disabilities. Approved 2022, under construction as of HEFSP. Generates 8 bedrooms + 8 supportive/special needs bonus = 16 total credits (Table 23).

sites.quote: Life Opportunities Unlimited – Block 134.01, Lot 9. This property is a group home occupied by persons with intellectual and developmental disabilities which opened in 2023. A total of four resident bedrooms are included in the development.
sites.notes: 4-bedroom group home, opened 2023. Generates 4 bedrooms + 4 supportive/special needs bonus = 8 total credits (Table 23).

sites.current_zoning: Condemnation area in need of redevelopment
sites.proposed_zoning: Inclusionary mixed-use redevelopment (max 33 du/acre, 15% rental / 20% ownership set-aside)
sites.quote: Harrison Avenue Redevelopment – Block 107, Lots 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11. In March 2024, the Mayor and Council of the Borough of Waldwick directed the Planning Board to undertake a condemnation area in need of redevelopment study for Block 107. The Planning Board recommended that the study area be designated as a condemnation area in need of redevelopment, and the Mayor and Council concurred with the Planning Board's recommendation. A redevelopment plan was subsequently prepared and adopted for a portion of the study area with an area of 1.278 acres. The redevelopment plan includes a maximum density of 33 units per acre and requires a minimum of 15 percent of all rental units or 20 percent of all ownership units within the redevelopment plan area to be set aside for low- and moderate-income households. A site plan application has been filed with the Planning Board for an inclusionary mixed-use development with 42 dwelling units, including six affordable units. The application is in the process of being reviewed by the Planning Board.
sites.notes: Site plan application for 42 units/6 affordable pending Planning Board review. Generates 6 rental units + 3 transit bonus = 9 total credits (Table 23). Partially addresses Fourth Round RDP of 5 units. HEFSP notes 5 RDP units addressed by non-age-restricted rental units from 1 Franklin Turnpike and Harrison Ave combined.

sites.proposed_zoning: AHO-1 Affordable Housing Overlay Zone-1 (multifamily/mixed-use; 15 du/acre, 20% sale / 15% rental set-aside)
sites.quote: The AHO-1 Affordable Housing Overlay Zone-1 is proposed to cover the existing VC-3 zone and a portion of the VC-2 Zone on the east side of the New Jersey Transit railroad tracks. Within the AHO-1 Zone, the following standards shall apply: ... The minimum affordable housing set-aside shall be 20% of the dwelling units in the development, except that the minimum set-aside shall be 15% where [rental units].
sites.notes: Unmet Need mechanism for 159-unit unmet need. Existing max density 10 du/acre; proposed 15 du/acre (50% increase). Set-aside: 20% ownership / 15% rental. No specific block/lot identified — covers entire VC-3 zone and portion of VC-2 zone east of NJ Transit tracks.
